function.name: read
function.description: Read a text file with line numbers; the first line gives its size. Pages of up to 2000 lines: continue with offset.

file.description: File path, relative to the project root or absolute.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace one exact, unique occurrence of a text in a file with new text. Copy the text from read output without the line numbers.

find.description: Exact text to replace; must be unique in the file.

function.name: write
function.description: Create a file, or replace a whole file you have read, with the given content.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a bash command in the project and return its exit code and output. The working directory persists between calls.

timeout_s.description: Time limit in seconds, at most 600.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents line by line with a regular expression (Rust syntax: escape [ ] ( ) { } . * + ? | \ to match them literally); returns path:line:text for each match.

glob.description: Only files matching this glob, e.g. *.rs.

path.description: Directory or file to search; default the project root.

function.name: glob
function.description: List files whose path matches a glob pattern such as **/*.rs, newest first.

path.description: Directory to search; default the project root.
